hotspots.title: Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Staff, faces mounting allegations of illicit enrichment and false asset declarations. Opposition parties are pushing for his removal, while President Milei continues to support him despite growing internal and external pressure.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral charge, polarizing contention between the government and opposition, and raising questions about governance integrity under Milei’s administration.

hotspots.title: Trump’s Iran deal sparks global controversy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump signed a memorandum of understanding with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address Tehran’s nuclear program. The deal has drawn mixed reactions globally, with some praising it as a diplomatic breakthrough and others criticizing it as a surrender.
hotspots.affect: The deal is highly charged due to its geopolitical implications, Trump’s framing of it as a triumph, and the polarized reactions from international allies and adversaries.

hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism and legal battles escalate
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces growing legal scrutiny, including investigations into extremism and internal power struggles. The party’s rising poll numbers and controversial policies continue to fuel public outrage and protests.
hotspots.affect: The AfD’s legal battles and extremist rhetoric command intense affective investment due to fears of democratic backsliding, moral outrage over racist incidents, and polarized contention over immigration and national identity.

hotspots.title: Vox’s rising influence in Spain’s regions
hotspots.blurb: Vox continues to expand its political influence in Spain’s regional governments, particularly in Andalusia and Valencia, where it is pushing for policy changes on immigration, LGBTQ+ rights, and national sovereignty. The party’s aggressive rhetoric and coalition negotiations with the PP are sparking backlash from left-wing parties.
hotspots.affect: Vox’s influence is highly charged due to its moral and cultural battles, polarized contention with left-wing parties, and alarmist framing of its policies as threats to democracy and social cohesion.

hotspots.title: PiS’s internal feuds and scandals intensify
hotspots.blurb: Poland’s ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party is grappling with internal divisions, public scandals involving preferential treatment in hospitals, and tensions with Germany over historical grievances. The party’s leadership under Jarosław Kaczyński faces growing criticism from both within and outside the party.
hotspots.affect: The internal feuds and scandals are highly charged due to their moral implications, polarized contention with opposition parties, and the leadership crisis tone surrounding Kaczyński’s authority.
